title: Contrato de tutores, pacientes e cadastros auxiliares

allowedImplementation: runtime request validation for the current OpenAPI/shared-contract wire shape
tenant-scoped duplicate prevention in the process-local service
bounded pagination metadata already declared by the OpenAPI surface
forbidden: reconciling the incompatible packages/contracts DTO without API/Product authority
changing remuneration, clinical, import or relationship policy
claiming database/RLS, UAT, Vetus parity or production acceptance

dependencyReplan.note: A fatia local endurece a fronteira pública e registra o contrato; não satisfaz nenhuma dependência integral.

productDecisionsPending: duplicate identity key and merge policy
auxiliary catalog ownership and patient linkage

ownerCreate.status: active is assigned by the service

contractDrift.competingSurface: packages/contracts uses document/phoneMain/ownerId while the current runtime/OpenAPI uses documentId/contacts/primaryOwnerId
contractDrift.rule: The boundary parser follows the current runtime/OpenAPI DTO and does not silently assert that the competing package is equivalent.

invariants.rule: A request body must be a JSON object and required fields must have the declared runtime type.
Nested owner contacts and profile objects are validated before service mutation.
Owner duplicate detection is scoped to the same account and applies to create and update.
Patient duplicate detection is scoped to the same account and applies to create and update.
List pagination is bounded and returns total before slicing; no tenant filter is bypassed.
Cross-account owner, patient and relationship reads remain hidden by the route boundary.
A primary relationship cannot be deleted or created for a different primary owner.
A local green test does not promote database/RLS, import, UAT, parity or domain acceptance.

scenarioCatalog.case: Create and update an owner with nested contact/profile data.
scenarioCatalog.expected: Canonical fields are normalized and persisted by the current service path.

scenarioCatalog.case: Create and update a patient with a primary owner.
scenarioCatalog.expected: The primary relationship is represented and remains tenant-scoped.

scenarioCatalog.case: Malformed JSON object shape, nested contact, enum or finite numeric value.

scenarioCatalog.expected: ConflictError is returned within the same account; another account is not blocked.

scenarioCatalog.case: Read or mutate an owner/patient/link belonging to another tenant.
scenarioCatalog.expected: NotFound or filtered response; no cross-tenant data is returned.
items are sliced after tenant/status filters and metadata reports the pre-slice total.

scenarioCatalog.case: Create, update, archive and merge owner-patient relationships.
scenarioCatalog.expected: Primary/link invariants and audit hooks remain enforced.

scenarioCatalog.case: Compare local implementation with DB migrations and the competing package contract.
scenarioCatalog.expected: Differences remain explicit and require API/Product/DB authority before reconciliation.

failureCases.trigger: NaN, Infinity or wrong numeric type

failureCases.expected: ValidationError instead of a silent no-op

failureCases.trigger: same owner identity duplicated in one account
same patient name and primary owner duplicated in one account
page, pageSize or limit outside safe bounds
attempt to treat local tests as DB/RLS/UAT/owner acceptance

observations.localImplementation: Boundary parser wired into owner/patient/link/merge routes; duplicate identity checks are account-scoped on create/update; paginated owner/patient responses now expose total/page/pageSize when requested.
notProven: atomic cross-table transaction for patient/link/merge persistence

promotionRule: PROD-063 may not become DONE from this contract or local unit/route tests. Promotion requires dependencies, approved wire/policy decisions, private DB/RLS proof, UI/API/DB reconciliation, import/archival cases, fresh independent review and owner acceptance.
